map.由磁量子数求磁矩: Find magnetic moment from magnetic quantum number
map.输入磁量子数 m_l，求轨道磁矩（以 μ_B 为单位）。: Enter magnetic quantum number m_l to obtain the orbital magnetic moment (in units of mu_B).
map.📖 查看「由磁量子数求磁矩 使用指南」: 📖 View "Find Magnetic Moment from Magnetic Quantum Number - User Guide"
map.电子自旋磁矩取值。: Values of the electron spin magnetic moment.
map.磁共振/塞曼分裂量级。: Magnitude of magnetic resonance / Zeeman splitting.
map.磁矩与玻尔磁子换算。: Convert magnetic moment to Bohr magneton.
map.|μ_s|=g_s μ_B/2≈9.27e-24 J/T（g_s≈2），恰好 1: |mu_s| = g_s mu_B/2 approx 9.27e-24 J/T (g_s approx 2), exactly 1 Bohr magneton.
map.玻尔磁子 9.274e-24 J/T，原子磁矩的自然单位。: Bohr magneton 9.274e-24 J/T, the natural unit of atomic magnetic moment.
map.形式相同 μ=μ_B·m_l，自旋 g 因子为 2。: Same form mu = mu_B m_l; the spin g-factor is 2.
map.轨道磁矩（本页代码口径）：μ=μ_B×m_l（μ_B=9.2740100783×: Orbital magnetic moment (this page's code basis): μ = μ_B×m_l (μ_B = 9.2740100783×10⁻²⁴ J/T the Bohr magneton, m_l the magnetic quantum number); linked values: magnetic moment (in μ_B) = m_l, Zeeman splitting energy per tesla = μ×5.7883818×10⁻⁵ (eV/T, i.e. m_l×5.7883818×10⁻⁵; μ_B = 5.7883818×10⁻⁵ eV/T). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; m_l takes integers from −l to +l, and the moment direction reverses with its sign.
